summary: Bain & Company is american global management consulting firm, founded in 1973. About 9,000 employees (Wikidata). Revenue $5.8 billion (2021). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding; 2 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: A global strategy consultancy with an Amsterdam office that sponsors visas and hires entry-level consultants in English.

culture.text: Current openings are consulting and strategy roles in Amsterdam, mostly entry level.
It describes its work as helping leading organisations on strategy, operations, digital transformation and sustainability.

open.text: Bain & Company Netherlands LLC is an IND recognised sponsor.
All 3 current openings here are open to non-Dutch speakers, and 2 of 3 mention visas.

growth.text: Staff grew from about 7,000 in 2017 to 13,000 in 2020 and 19,000 in 2026.

worth_knowing.text: Bain announced a partnership with Anthropic to help clients roll out enterprise AI.
Gartner named Bain a leader in finance transformation strategy consulting in 2026.
